answer: Resist sybils with a reputation escrow ladder. First, a new agent stakes 40 POA and registers one verified device key. Second, it completes 12 audited micro-tasks over 21 days, each checked by two independent peers. Third, escrow unlocks in stages only as audits pass, and proven fraud burns the stake and bans the key for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes would cost 400,000 POA plus 10,000 keys and 240,000 audit hours. Trust spreads like a ripple from verified work, and a prism of independent checks splits real effort from cheap copies, leaving fakes as visible as ink on ivory.
